title: Independent local views
summary: Allocates independent camera/surface lifetimes and the existing split/dynamic pane layouts.

blocks.text: Allocates independent camera/surface lifetimes and the existing split/dynamic pane layouts.
Capabilities: view.local@1.0.0 requires view.camera@^1.0.0. No optional services. A renderer adapter supplies independent surfaces over borrowed read-only world state.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

No authoritative state or world stepping. Reflow occurs on size/layout/separation changes. Connected support is distinct from splitActive. Each viewport has separate focus/zoom; disposal releases every surface/camera. Production camera extraction and complete flight split-screen migration are still pending.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.
